items.title: Right derived functors of the inclusion of abelian sheaves into presheaves are the cohomology presheaves
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the right derived functors of the inclusion of abelian sheaves into abelian presheaves with the cohomology presheaves U -> H^p(U, F) (statement lines 1447-1458). The proof is a definitional computation: left exactness is immediate, and after choosing an injective resolution in Ab(C) the derived functors are the cohomology presheaves of the resolution complex, whose sections over U are kernel modulo image of the section complex, which is precisely the definition of H^p(U, F) (proof lines 1461-1471). The claim is H2: one definition unfolded carefully, with no additional construction.
